title: C5 composition representation and execution budget audit
question: Which registered representation and verifier-coupled training interventions reduce compositional rank degradation and the admission-to-execution budget loss in the persistent relational C5 loop?
hypothesis: The principal loss will separate into relation representation, LSH admission, and execution-budget effects; structured relational representations and outcome-coupled hard negatives may reduce dense rank and move verified targets toward small execution budgets without changing the persistent substrate or verifier.

arms.name: control
arms.intervention: existing persistent relational CDL router with matched 1200 exhaustive updates

arms.name: analytic_init
arms.intervention: exact signed Boolean relational initialization with an explicit persisted-operation constant channel, followed by matched 1200 exhaustive updates

arms.name: product_key
arms.intervention: split candidate descriptors into two 8-bit product-key subspaces with learned 8-D subkeys

arms.name: late_interaction
arms.intervention: independent per-bit query/candidate channels with summed interaction score

arms.name: outcome_distill
arms.intervention: control with 800 exhaustive updates followed by 400 pairwise updates from actual CASM verification failures

arms.name: product_key_distill
arms.intervention: product-key representation with 800 exhaustive updates followed by 400 CASM-failure hard-negative updates

arms.name: late_interaction_distill
arms.intervention: per-bit interaction representation with 800 exhaustive updates followed by 400 CASM-failure hard-negative updates

decision_rule.condition: Report control mean dense target rank as expected exact-verifier executions across M=64..8192 and report the pooled finite-range power fit.
decision_rule.does_not_license: an asymptotic theorem or a generic complexity claim.

decision_rule.condition: Report empirical L90(M) at every registered M using the smallest integer L with at least 0.90 target collision on calibration; do not replace it with the iid estimate.
decision_rule.does_not_license: an optimal table count outside the registered operating rule.

decision_rule.condition: Report calibration and held-out counts, digests, and zero intersection; do not select an arm from held-out results.
decision_rule.licenses: an auditable split and preregistered arm comparison.

decision_rule.condition: Report per-operation XOR/XNOR/AND/OR routing performance and the baseline feature inventory before attributing failure to composition difficulty.
decision_rule.licenses: a representability diagnosis for the registered synthetic workload.

decision_rule.condition: Report fixed execution-budget curves and the preregistered adaptive policy against exact verification.
decision_rule.licenses: a representation-versus-budget tradeoff on this workload.
decision_rule.does_not_license: a claim that the adaptive policy is generally optimal.

decision_rule.condition: Use the exact persistent relational hash solver only as a task-semantic capability/cost reference.
decision_rule.does_not_license: calling the exact solver learned retrieval.

held_constant: two persisted 16-bit operands plus persisted operation
three-boundary persistence delay with three decoy writes
opaque address plus one-bit-corrupted public operation hint
64 calibration and 64 held-out trials per seed/M
interpretation_order: baseline feature and per-operation representability gate
